# menu-bar-task

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The menu-bar panel's task field (MenuBar.Section 'task'): an autogrowing textarea (up to six lines, then it scrolls) — Enter files the text as one top-level task through the task-draft form's submitChain (POST /api/tasks/chain) with every launch option at its default, so auto-start behaves as in Improve; Shift+Enter adds a line, Escape clears. Its text is the panel's input (usePanelInput): the app grid filters by it as it is typed, and it is kept as a draft across reloads. The field confirms inline ('Filed — …') or shows why the submit failed.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `MenuBar.Section` "Task" → `MenuBarTaskField`
  - Uses:
    - `infra/endpoints.useFetchEndpoint`
